WITH period_info AS (
  SELECT 
    weeks_in_period
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period_label = 'FY2026/27 P05'
),
stock_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as quantity_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.category, sb.category) as category,
  COALESCE(s.closing_units, 0) as closing_units,
  COALESCE(sb.quantity_sold, 0) as quantity_sold_period,
  pi.weeks_in_period,
  CASE 
    WHEN COALESCE(sb.quantity_sold, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(s.closing_units, 0) * pi.weeks_in_period / COALESCE(sb.quantity_sold, 0)::DECIMAL, 2)
  END as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_category s
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_by_category sb ON s.category = sb.category
CROSS JOIN period_info pi
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.category, sb.category);

WITH period_info AS (
  SELECT 
    weeks_in_period
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period_label = 'FY2026/27 P05'
),
stock_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fs.closing_units) as closing_units
  FROM fact_stock_week fs
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fs.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fs.week_ending_date = '2026-09-27'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
),
sales_by_category AS (
  SELECT 
    dp.category,
    SUM(fsl.quantity) as quantity_sold
  FROM fact_sales_line fsl
  JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
  WHERE fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31' AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    AND dp.category != 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY dp.category
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(s.category, sb.category) as category,
  ROUND(COALESCE(s.closing_units, 0) * pi.weeks_in_period / COALESCE(sb.quantity_sold, 1)::DECIMAL, 2) as weeks_of_cover
FROM stock_by_category s
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_by_category sb ON s.category = sb.category
CROSS JOIN period_info pi
ORDER BY category;
